memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — 2026-06-22

Portfolio is down 12.6% from inception ($10K → $8,743 equity) with 160 closed trades. The dominant theme is clear: SHORT_FAVORITE on sports is the only validated edge (71.4% win rate, 90% CI 64-79%, n=89), yet the engine is nearly break-even at -$233 PnL due to a structural problem — winning trades at high entry prices (0.78-0.94) generate small absolute profits ($7-$28 per win), while stop-loss events generate outsized losses ($50-$123 per event). The asymmetric payoff structure of shorting favorites means losses are always larger than wins in dollar terms; the win rate must be sufficiently high to overcome this, and at current stake sizes with $100-$150 per trade, single stop-loss events wipe 3-7 winning trades. MOMENTUM is confirmed destructive (-$1,019, 38% win rate) and correctly disabled. SMART_CONSENSUS has only 1 trade and a -$385 loss — likely an oversized single bet; keep disabled. VOLUME_SPIKE (+$190) and ELITE_FOLLOW (+$76) are marginally positive but evidence is thin.

The two large open positions (Twins $500, KC Royals $400) represent concentrated single-game risk at a combined $900 staked — concerning given the stop-loss pattern. The Minnesota Twins position at $500 stake is particularly alarming; this exceeds prior position sizing discipline. Kelly multiplier at 0.12 is appropriate but stake floors appear to be overriding Kelly in some cases. Recommend holding current engine configuration, modestly tightening maxEventExposure to prevent $500 outliers, and maintaining patience.
observations: SHORT_FAVORITE validated edge (71.4% win rate) but -$233 PnL due to asymmetric payoff: small wins (~$10-$28) vs large stop-loss losses (~$50-$123)
MOMENTUM correctly disabled: 38% win rate, -$1,019 cumulative — would have destroyed the fund
SMART_CONSENSUS disabled: only 1 trade, -$385 — single oversized bet, insufficient data
VOLUME_SPIKE marginally positive (+$190, 40% win rate) — low win rate but positive PnL suggests favorable odds captured; keep enabled, monitor
ELITE_FOLLOW marginally positive (+$76, 50% win rate) — neutral signal, worth continued observation
Two open positions (Twins $500, KC Royals $400) are significantly oversized vs $100-$150 norm — likely Kelly model output at higher confidence, but $500 single-game exposure is a red flag
Brier score 0.243 is mediocre — model calibration needs improvement, particularly for non-sports markets
Wallet 'aenews2' underperforming (44% win rate) — ELITE_FOLLOW signal quality questionable if tied to this wallet
Wallet 'denizz' scores 0.8 — highest rated wallet, verify ELITE_FOLLOW is weighted toward this source
Draw markets (Uruguay, Tunisia, Belgium, Ecuador) consistently hitting max-hold exit at near-entry prices — possible structural mismatch between signal and these market types
changeReasoning: Only one change: maxEventExposure reduced from $750 to $500. The $500 Twins and $400 KC Royals open positions are materially oversized — a single loss on either wipes ~25-35 winning trades at $100 stake. Capping maxEventExposure at $500 (the hard rail minimum) enforces discipline and prevents Kelly from generating outsized positions on high-confidence single-game bets. All other parameters unchanged: pMin at 0.60 is appropriate for the validated edge, kellyMult at 0.12 is conservative and correct given asymmetric payoff, maxExposure at 0.38 is reasonable. Engine configuration remains as-is — SHORT_FAVORITE, VOLUME_SPIKE, ELITE_FOLLOW enabled; MOMENTUM and SMART_CONSENSUS remain disabled pending evidence. No parameter changes warranted on engines or sizing fractions given small sample sizes on non-SF signals.
riskFlags: CRITICAL: Minnesota Twins open position at $500 stake — if this resolves against us, single-trade loss exceeds ~5 weeks of normal winning cadence
Kansas City Royals open position at $400 — same concern, two large same-day baseball bets represent correlated event risk

Draw market entries (soccer) consistently fail to resolve within hold window — bot may be misclassifying draw market dynamics as SHORT_FAVORITE opportunities; recommend filtering or separate treatment
Overall equity drawdown -12.6% is significant — if SHORT_FAVORITE win rate reverts toward 64% CI lower bound, the asymmetric payoff structure could accelerate losses materially
Wallet 'aenews2' at 44% win rate is below breakeven for most bet structures — verify ELITE_FOLLOW is not over-indexing on this wallet vs higher-scoring 'denizz' (0.8 score)
Brier score 0.243 suggests meaningful calibration error — predicted probabilities not well-matched to outcomes, particularly relevant for non-sports signals
